en: My word, how fond your Pokémon is of you! I can see it in its eyes. You're just the trainer I've been waiting for.
I have a Pokémon Egg I'd like raised by someone like you. Would you take it?
{player} received an Egg from the gentleman!
Take good care of it. Love it as your Pokémon loves you.
Ah, but you have no room for it on your team. Come back once you've made some.
A trainer and a Pokémon who trust each other completely are a fine thing to see. Treat yours well, won't you?
How is the Egg? Whatever hatches from it, I'm sure it will grow up happy with you.
